response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Their C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. They have no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was retail investment fintech, not capital markets), and no evident SQL Server/Oracle depth. The overlap is limited to peripheral desirables like CI/CD, scripting, and some Java.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience with strong testing and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Broad polyglot skill set including scripting languages, DevOps tooling, and some Java
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, versus the mandatory 5–10 years on Windows
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is mainly MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and performance systems background
